useCases.title: AI BIM Coordinator

showcase.problem: Rising complexity and responsibility in BIM coordination under Singapore's Corenet X mandate, which requires fully coordinated BIM models for design gateway submissions. Traditional clash detection generates thousands of unstructured clashes, many false positives or minor errors, overwhelming coordinators and diverting focus from critical design issues.
showcase.proposedSolution: AI-driven solution leveraging Google Gemini 2.0 for advanced clash analysis, using n8n for data processing and PyRevit for Revit integration. The AI filters out low-priority clashes, assigns actionable items to the right disciplines, and provides resolution instructions.
showcase.approach: Integrated workflow using Google Gemini 2.0, n8n for automation, and PyRevit for Revit integration to process and prioritize clash detection results.
showcase.methods: AI-powered filtering and classification of clashes, automated assignment to disciplines, intelligent resolution recommendations.
showcase.tools: Google Gemini 2.0, n8n, PyRevit, Navisworks, Revit
showcase.impact: Substantial reductions in irrelevant clashes, faster processing, improved accuracy in identifying high-impact issues, accelerated feedback loops, cost savings, and more efficient design resolution. Future plans include platform-agnostic tools and automated reporting.

useCases.summary: The AI BIM Coordinator streamlines BIM clash detection under Singaporeâ€™s Corenet X mandate by using AI to filter and prioritize issues, significantly reducing manual effort, improving accuracy, and accelerating design coordination through tools like Google Gemini 2.0, n8n, and PyRevit.

useCases.title: SketchUp IFC AI-Classifier

showcase.problem: Unstructured and poorly classified BIM components disrupt downstream workflows and reduce digital coordination credibility. SketchUp models contain thousands of objects from various sources lacking proper IFC classification, metadata, or layer assignment, leading to delays, errors, and significant manual cleanup.
showcase.proposedSolution: SketchUp plugin integrated with agentic AI workflow: TensorFlow for visual recognition, GPT-4o for initial classification and metadata, GPT-o3-mini for validation and reasoning, and GPT-4o-mini for clean BIM data output.
showcase.approach: Multi-stage AI pipeline combining computer vision and language models for intelligent classification and validation.
showcase.methods: Visual recognition using TensorFlow, AI-powered classification and metadata assignment, validation through reasoning models, automated BIM data structuring.
showcase.impact: 95% classification accuracy, 18 seconds average processing per object, dramatic reduction in manual workload, ensures compliance and collaboration readiness, raises overall productivity. Next steps include user-supplied API keys and Revit compatibility.

useCases.summary: The SketchUp AI Classifier is a plugin that automates BIM component organization to solve the problem of unstructured models disrupting downstream workflows, delivering 95% classification accuracy and high-speed processing through an agentic AI pipeline powered by TensorFlow and GPT-based tools.

useCases.title: LLMs Augmented Generative Design

showcase.problem: Current generative design tools in Rhino-Grasshopper demand extensive human input, making the process labor-intensive and limiting creative exploration. Core challenges include extracting rich geometric information from images, deploying LLM agents to interact with parametric scripts, and generating accurate GhPython code for complex design tasks.
showcase.proposedSolution: Proof of concept exploring how LLMs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can automate geometry extraction, code generation, and iterative design refinement in Rhino-Grasshopper environment.
showcase.approach: Investigating LLM agents to interact with parametric scripts, potentially leveraging RAG for improved accuracy in automated design workflows.
showcase.methods: Automated geometry extraction from images, AI-powered GhPython code generation, iterative design refinement through LLM agents.
showcase.impact: Highlights potential to make computational design faster, more accessible, and intuitive. Future development focuses on expanding input methods, refining prompts, introducing specialized geometry agents, and integrating with ETABS and Revit.

useCases.summary: This PoC explores how LLMs and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) can streamline generative design in Rhinoâ€“Grasshopper by automating geometry extraction and GhPython code generation, addressing the manual bottlenecks that limit creativity, and using AI agents to enhance accuracy, accessibility, and integration with tools like ETABS and Revit.

useCases.title: Deffy AI â€“ TOP Inspection

showcase.problem: Manual site inspections and report generation in construction are inefficient and risky. Site teams spend hours recording defects, cross-referencing codes, and compiling reports, leading to delays, errors, and commercial risks.
showcase.proposedSolution: Telegram-based AI chatbot powered by OpenAI GPT-4.1, enabling users to input unstructured data (images, text, voice) during site walks. AI processes data, cross-references regulatory codes using RAG, assesses defect severity, and generates standardized inspection reports.
showcase.approach: Mobile-first chatbot interface integrated with AI processing pipeline and regulatory knowledge base through RAG.
showcase.methods: Multimodal input processing (images, text, voice), RAG-based code compliance checking, automated defect severity assessment, standardized report generation.
showcase.impact: 5X productivity boost, reducing report generation from 150 to 30 minutes, 80% accuracy in compliance checks. Frees professionals for higher-value tasks, improves report quality and code compliance, serves as learning tool. useCases.summary: Deffy is a Telegram-based AI chatbot that automates defect reporting and compliance checks on construction sites, addressing the inefficiencies of manual inspections by processing unstructured inputs through GPT-4.1 and RAG to generate accurate, standardized reports 5X faster, freeing professionals for higher-value tasks and enhancing site quality, compliance, and learning.

useCases.title: ThinkSync AI Notes Processor

showcase.problem: This project addresses inefficiencies and miscommunication caused by fragmented project documentation, where critical updates, decisions, and files are scattered across emails, chats, and cloud storage, making it difficult for teams to stay aligned and act quickly. The core problem is the manual, time-consuming sorting and retrieval of relevant information from large volumes of unstructured emails and meeting notes, leading to delays, errors, and lost data.
showcase.proposedSolution: The solution leverages AI agents and automation tools (such as OpenAI GPT-4o and Microsoft Power Automate) to extract, classify, and structure emails and meeting notes within an integrated Microsoft 365 workflow. This enables teams to query important decisions while modeling, with parallel automated reviews of model areas in Revit against meeting minutes and guidelines. The system sends Teams notifications to highlight inconsistencies for user correction in real time.
showcase.approach: Integration of AI-powered document processing with Microsoft 365 workflow, parallel validation of design decisions against meeting documentation, real-time notification system for inconsistency detection.
showcase.methods: AI agents for content extraction and classification, automated cross-referencing between models and documentation, intelligent querying system, real-time validation and notification.
showcase.tools: OpenAI GPT-4o, Microsoft Power Automate, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Revit
showcase.impact: Outcomes include up to 70% time savings in manual sorting, improved accuracy, faster query responses, and streamlined documentation, enabling teams to focus on higher-value tasks while reducing miscommunication and operational risks.

useCases.summary: This project uses AI agents and tools like GPT-4o and Power Automate to solve the inefficiencies of fragmented project documentation by automatically extracting, structuring, and querying unstructured emails and meeting notes, achieving up to 70% time savings, improving accuracy, and reducing miscommunication across teams.

useCases.title: BIM 3D to 5D/6D Spec AI Agent

showcase.problem: The solution addresses the challenge of communicating and integrating data from designers' BIM 3D models to downstream processes for quantity surveying and facilities management, which currently requires manual and error-prone workflows for generating specifications and maintenance checklists. This gap arises because existing tools struggle with seamless data exchange between BIM authoring software and downstream applications, leading to inefficiencies and delays in project documentation.
showcase.proposedSolution: The approach leverages AI agents like Google Vertex AI Gemini to query CSV data filtered from IFC model; uses generative AI to draft tailored specifications and checklists, and integrates historical templates and schedules of rates for improved accuracy and scalability.
showcase.approach: Multi-stage AI workflow integrating BIM data extraction, AI-powered specification generation, and template-based enhancement for quantity surveying and facility management outputs.
showcase.methods: IFC data extraction and filtering, AI-powered query processing, generative AI for specification drafting, integration with historical templates and rate schedules.
showcase.tools: Google Vertex AI Gemini, IFC viewers/processors, CSV data tools, specification and rate databases
showcase.impact: The outcomes include significant time savings, streamlined workflows, the ability to quickly generate accurate first drafts, and a scalable foundation for future project adoption.

useCases.summary: This solution automates the conversion of BIM 3D data into specifications and maintenance checklists using Google Vertex AI Gemini, addressing manual inefficiencies by querying filtered IFC data and applying generative AI with historical templates, enabling faster, more accurate, and scalable documentation for QS and FM.

useCases.title: AI Contract Management

Current methods are plagued by manual processes, fragmented document handling, and a lack of real-time visibility, which cause delays, disputes, cost overruns, and compliance challengesâ€”especially in multi-stakeholder environments with complex contract standards.
showcase.proposedSolution: The solution leverages generative AI (e.g., GPT-based models) for contract drafting and clause analysis, AI agents for real-time obligation monitoring, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for intelligent search and dispute resolution, and blockchain for automated milestone payments and audit trailsâ€”all integrated with project and site data via common BIM and project-management platforms.
showcase.approach: Comprehensive AI-powered contract lifecycle management integrating GPT-based drafting, intelligent monitoring agents, RAG-powered search, and blockchain automation within BIM-integrated project workflows.
showcase.methods: AI-powered contract drafting and analysis, real-time obligation monitoring with AI agents, RAG for intelligent search and dispute resolution, blockchain-based milestone payments and audit trails, BIM and project management integration.
showcase.tools: GPT-based models, AI agents, RAG systems, blockchain platforms, BIM software, project management platforms
showcase.impact: Key benefits include very substantial improvements in contract review time, very substantial reductions in legal disputes, enhanced compliance with international standards, greater project visibility, and streamlined automated paymentsâ€”resulting in faster approvals, lower costs, and increased stakeholder trust.

useCases.summary: This project introduces an AI-powered contract management solution that integrates GPT-based drafting, AI agents, RAG search, and blockchain to streamline construction contracts, reducing delays, disputes, and costs while improving compliance, transparency, and payment automation across BIM-integrated workflows.
